description: The actual syntax-summary clause for addition or multiplication combines valid term children by maximum depth and name bounds, and rejects invalid term children.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.stats_binary_modelNode_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (f : ℕ) (hf : f = 2 ∨ f = 3) (a b : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.stats.value
      ![Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 2
          [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M f, a, b]] =
    if
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.statsPart 0 a =
            Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∨
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.statsPart 0 b =
            Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M then
      Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
    else
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelSummary
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.maximum.value
          ![Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.maximum.value
              ![Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1,
                Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.statsPart 0 a],
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.statsPart 0 b])
        (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.maximum.value
          ![Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.maximum.value
              ![Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M,
                Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.statsPart 2 a],
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.statsPart 2 b])
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.maximum.value
          ![Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.maximum.value
              ![Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M,
                Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.statsPart 3 a],
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.statsPart 3 b])
